summary: ChatWidget: the artifact container, as one shell with two payload families. The Text sheet's Not built row asked for one item covering three families; it ships covering TWO, and the third — questionnaire — is `chat-questionnaire`, because the questionnaire sheet draws no container at all: no fill, no header, no action bar, so six of this component's parts mean nothing to it (§7a's Sheet-and-Drawer test). The disagreement is between the two sheets, is recorded in both docs, and the drawings settle it. Compound parts: Root, Header, Body, Media, Rail, Caption, Actions. THREE THINGS WORTH READING. (1) The concentric rule the media sheet says breaks visibly — radius-lg outer, an 8px inset, radius-md inner — is asserted as ARITHMETIC (outer === inner + padding) in the browser test and declared as the repo's only `concentric-radius` geometry case; the media's radius sits on the slot node as well as on its sizer, because a radius living only on an inner sizer is one the laws cannot reach. (2) The body's 320px cap makes it a SCROLLABLE REGION, and the role, the name and the tab stop are applied together and only WHILE it actually overflows — measured with a ResizeObserver over the box and its children, since the content is streamed in. `scrollLabel` is required by the type: an unconditional tab stop in front of every short draft and a nameless reachable region are the same defect wearing different clothes. (3) The sheet raised the bottom fade as a Conflict — a gradient from bg-elevated to its own transparent, which no colour token can express, so either a gradient token pair is minted or the implementation derives it. It is derived: `from-elevated to-transparent`, two stops the theme already has, which resolves the Conflict without a token. Also found by the story-a11y run and recorded rather than papered over: the sheet's generating media state puts a Progress on the dark media ground, where Progress's --ui-text-muted label measures under AA.
